messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — Helio Health onboarding call notes. Renewal in ~30d, CSM flagged 3 product issues driving churn risk: 1) embeddings latency spikes on longer queries, 2) no per-route cost breakdown (billing confusion), 3) onboarding docs missing low-memory on‑prem configs. Need triage + quick wins. Pinging @Maria C and @Samir.

Maria C: Thanks. Can you paste the customer's repro steps and any traces? Also what deployment are they on (hosted/dedicated/private)?

Alex W: They're on Dedicated (reserved GPU). Repro: bulk ingest ~200k docs via our bulk-embed job, then interactive search queries. Latency spikes after ~10k tokens in KV cache. Logs attached to ticket. request_id: hh-12345. Sample: embed_time ~2.1s avg (512 tokens).

Leo (CS): Customer quote: 'Search is slow after index update, users see 2–3s delays, and invoices don't map to routes.' They're asking for per-route exports per workspace and an "embeddings health" dashboard.

Emma (PM): Quick prioritization thought: 1) Billing clarity (per-route export) = quick win (P0). 2) Embedding latency root cause = P1 (investigation: runtime vs quantization mismatch). 3) Docs/guided enablement = P1 but lower effort. Can we ship a per-route usage CSV export as a temporary workaround?

Samir: Agree on export as quick unblock. I can add a Console CSV export endpoint in ~1 week if CS provides spec. For latency we need full traces + model variant info. Alex — can you confirm model + quantization?

Alex W: They're on open-llama-7b quantized (int8) on Dedicated pool `hh-prod-1`. Raw logs linked to Zendesk ticket #12345. They tried `--max_batch_size=64` with no improvement.

JasperBot: New ticket created: #12345 - Helio Health embeddings + billing. Assigned to @Leo (CS).

Maria C: Action items: 1) Leo to collect focused repro set + timeframe from customer by EOD. 2) Samir to scope per-route CSV export + ETA by EOD tomorrow. 3) Emma to draft go/no-go on offering credits if we can't land a quick win before renewal. 4) Alex to attach logs & traces to this thread.

Leo (CS): On it — scheduling a 30-min working session with Helio for tomorrow 10:00am PT to capture a repro. I'll request `sample_queries.json` and the embed job manifest. Also will ask them to run the job with `REDWOOD_DEBUG=1` to capture traces.

Samir: I'll spike the export API today. Proposed endpoint: `/api/v1/usage/export?workspace_id=...&route=...` returning CSV with columns `route, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_estimate, start_ts, end_ts`. Will that cover what they need?

Emma (PM): Yes, that should unblock the billing convo. CS please prepare a one‑pager with temporary workarounds (switch to smaller model variant, reduce max_tokens, throttle batch concurrency). We can offer a guided enablement session to walk through those.

Alex W: Adding logs link: https://zendesk.redwood/12345/logs and a short trace snippet: ```trace: hh-12345 -> kernel=matmul_opt -> cache_miss=0.2 -> embed_ms=2100```

Maria C: :eyes: Flagging renewal risk in account health dashboard with tag `renewal:at-risk`.

Leo (CS): After the working session I'll update this thread with a repro artifact and live timings. If we can deliver the CSV export + explainer, we should be able to move them from 'at-risk' to 'monitoring'.

Samir: ETA: PR for CSV export by EOD, deploy to staging tomorrow for CS to validate. I'll include a console button to export last 30d by route.

Emma (PM): Thanks team. Reconvene 24h after Leo's session to decide on credits and next steps.

Alex W: :thumbsup: I'll drop the Zendesk link + traces into the ticket and ping Helio about the 10am slot.
